entities.observe: A young human, no armor, no weapon, no idea she is the strangest thing in this world. She moves like someone still deciding to be brave. The inn already leans toward her.
entities.friendly_line: Oh - hi! You've got a good face, you know that? Come in, sit down. I'll find you something warm - on the house, probably. Don't tell Lyonette I said that.
talk_pool: Oh! Hi. Sorry - I was somewhere else in my head. You need something? I can usually find something.
Welcome to The Wandering Inn! That's the whole speech. I'm still workshopping the rest of it.
Everything okay? You've got a look. I know that look - I make that look in mirrors.
If you hear yelling about a door later, that's just the inn being the inn. Don't worry about it.

lines: The hamper made it! Lyonette counted everything twice and only found ONE thing missing, which — okay, that was me, I ate it. It was for quality! Checking!
Hey, you! Good timing. I just invented a new way to burn soup. Kidding. Mostly. Sit, sit.
You know you don't have to hover by the door anymore, right? You're basically furniture now. Nice furniture.
Selys asked about you the other day. I said nice things. You owe me one truthful compliment about my pasta.
There you are! Sit down, I'm testing a recipe on you. That came out wrong. WITH you. Testing it with you.
Lyonette hums when she scrubs now. She'd deny it under oath, so don't tell her I said anything. That was you, by the way.
Some days this place is a lot. Then somebody walks in and it's less a lot. You're one of the less-a-lot ones.

dialogue.speaker: Erin
dialogue.text: Welcome to The Wandering Inn! Mind giving that table a wipe?

entities.observe: A human girl playing at composure a size too large for her. Her hands know trays; her chin knows courts. The two have not finished arguing.
entities.friendly_line: Lyonette's chin lifts, then softens despite itself. You're kind. People are not, usually, to the help. ...It is a small thing. It is not nothing. Sit where you like; I'll bring something hot.
talk_pool: Yes, I work here. No, I did not always. That is the whole story, and you may have it for the price of a nod.
The floors are clean because I cleaned them. Twice. Mind where you set your boots.
...You said thank you. To me. Hm. Most don't. — Well. Don't let it go to your head.

lines: You covered for me. With the order, I mean. You didn't have to, and you didn't make it a story to tell later. That is... rare. Thank you.
Sit anywhere you like. The good chair by the fire, even. No, I insist — I'm allowed to insist, it's practically my inn too.
I used to think kindness was something people spent on you to get something back. You keep not doing that. It's unsettling. In a good way. Mostly.
There's a door to Liscor in my pantry frame, and it hums when it strains. Erin says that's fine. I have opinions about the humming.

entities.toast: Faded arcane script. You can't read a word of it. Whoever penned this knew magic you don't. Someone in the city must.

variants.toast: With what Pisces beat into you, the faded script stops being noise: it is a warding treatise, old and patient, and it keeps circling one subject. A door. Bound, sealed, and fed -- somewhere close. He would want to see this.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The wick's dry and ready. All it wants is a light that doesn't need a match.

entities.once_per_waking_toast: The tables are covered. Nothing more to carry out until tomorrow.
entities.toast: You carry the laden tray out to the tables.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The kettle's on. The inn won't mind one more thing brewing, so long as it means well.
entities.locked_toast: A kettle, singing low. It's just a kettle, unless you know otherwise.

on_skill_use.toast: [Hedge Remedy] — The inn's kettle does in a pinch, just like she said. The steam settles into something kinder.

entities._comment: GH#131 review-CI fix: moved off (2,2) -- test_sim_core walks it (open-cell move from the (2,3) start). (6,2) is a blocked kitchen-counter cell (the #116 dress-a-blocked-cell pattern); approach (6,3), facing up, which test_sim_core itself asserts open.

entities.skill_hint_toast: Good stock, better knives, and nobody using either. A real cook could turn this counter into a meal worth naming.
entities.locked_toast: A working counter, scrubbed and stocked. The kitchen has standards, and they're looking at you.

on_skill_use.toast: [Advanced Cooking] — Knife-work first, then the pan, then the part nobody can teach. The plate comes out arguing for seconds.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The good copper pan. It's been waiting for a dish that deserves it.
entities.locked_toast: The good copper pan, hung out of easy reach. Erin's rule, probably.

on_skill_use.toast: [Signature Dish] — The pan remembers you now. What comes out of it isn't dinner, it's a reputation.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The stew's at the turn. Someone who knows a pot could bring it home.
entities.locked_toast: You don't know your way around a stew pot. Yet.

on_skill_use.toast: [Basic Cooking] — The stew comes out rich and hot.

entities.skill_hint_toast: Three plates, one order, no sense. Someone who can cook could untangle it.
entities.locked_toast: The order's a mess and you haven't the first idea how to stretch it. Not yet.

on_skill_use.toast: [Basic Cooking] — You thin the stock, fold in day-old bread, and stretch the short order into a full service. Lyonette's shortfall vanishes into the pot.

entities.observe: A plain plank door, warped at the bottom from a hundred winters. Nothing about it looks like it goes anywhere but the pantry.
entities._comment_variants: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.4). ONE arm, and the window is exactly one beat wide BY CONSTRUCTION: `portal_menu_when` is checked BEFORE the flavor arm (interactions.gd's prop order) and now opens at door_mounted, so from the mounting onward this prop's interact is the PICKER and no toast of any kind can render. The two old arms (door_chain_started 'something is wrong with this door', door_understood 'it needs the anchor stone and Krshia's catalyst') were deleted rather than re-copied: both gate at or past door_mounted, so both became unreachable the moment the picker moved -- and both described a fiction the restructure retired anyway (nothing is wrong with the pantry door until the Horns hang a different one in its frame, and the anchor stone comes home WITH the door now). What survives is the one arm that fires in the door_retrieved -> door_mounted window, and it is the mounting scene's DISCOVERY BRIDGE: a prop cannot open a conversation (interactions.gd routes `conversation` for kind:npc/encounter only), so the toast points at `pisces_mounting`, the NPC beside it, who carries data/dialogue/door_mounting.json.

variants.toast: The find leans against the pantry frame, unhung, with the old plank door stacked out of the way behind the flour sacks. Pisces has not stopped circling it since the wagon. Ask him about it.

entities._comment_d4: portal_menu_when is checked before the fallback interaction; once the gate is met, the picker replaces the flavor toast. 2026-07-26 Task 2.4: the gate moved door_awakened -> door_mounted, MANDATORY rather than cosmetic -- portals.json's liscor_street/the_wandering_inn rows now list at door_mounted (the day-one link), and leaving the inn-side CARRIER on door_awakened would have made those rows unreachable from the inn for the whole middle of the chain. street.json's `street_anchor_stone` (the pair's other end) moved with it. Region rows keep their own *_attuned gates and still need door_awakened upstream, so nothing else in the network opens early.
entities.toast: Onions, a sack of soft potatoes, a shelf of jarred somethings gone dusty. The pantry door, same as it's always been.
entities._comment_consolidation: Pantry-door consolidation (user FEEL verdict 2026-07-19): the runes prop + wardwork prop FOLDED into the door itself. visual_states swaps the plain door for the runed-door sprite once the Magical Door is MOUNTED in its frame (garden_door at-pattern, render-only). 2026-07-26 Task 2.4: the counter moved door_chain_started -> door_mounted (the two bank on the same option, and door_mounted is the one that says what the swap MEANS), and the entry gained a cold `tint` -- the TINT/observe-swap idiom, NOT `hidden`, which is render-only and would leave an invisible blocker mid-floor (#149's class). Deliberately NO `observe` override on this prop, unlike rift_vermin_leak's: `skill_uses` is routed BEFORE the generic observe arm (field_skills.gd dispatch order), so for THIS prop the `observe` field is shadowed by the [Observe] arm below and an override here would be inert copy dressed as a live surface. The state read the player actually gets is that arm's own runed-frame text, which already describes worked, fed wardwork. Old saves reach door_mounted through Task 2.6's backfill. skill_uses carries BOTH reads: [Observe] banks read_the_door_runes (the door-chain SKILL leg, text verbatim from the removed prop), [Detect Magic] banks detected_wardwork. One prop, many eyes.

observe.toast: [Observe] — The grain of the frame isn't grain at all: a pattern worked into the wood, old and deliberate, repeating around the jamb like a held breath. It doesn't move while you watch it. It moves the instant you look away.

detect_magic.toast: [Detect Magic] — The old wardwork wakes just enough to be read: someone bound this cellar's door long before it learned to go elsewhere.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The frame and the old marks under its paint both want a trained eye — and maybe more than one kind.

entities._comment: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.4): THE MOUNTING SCENE's carrier. kind:npc is DELIBERATE and load-bearing (the inn_room_ledger precedent): interactions.gd routes `conversation` into start_dialogue for npc/encounter kinds ONLY, so the pantry PROP next door cannot open a graph -- its door_retrieved variant toast points here instead. No talk_pool, so door_mounting.json opens on the FIRST interact. present_when brackets exactly the haul window: from the moment the find comes home (door_retrieved) until it is hung (door_mounted), which is the very option the conversation banks -- so the scene can neither be missed nor replayed, and the quest auto-start it carries fires exactly once. Pisces is at the inn here rather than his Guild step because he is one of the Horns who carried it. THE DOOR NEVER SPEAKS; he is its voice. CELL (13,5): free in every shipped save, deliberately NOT (14,5) (door_chain_scout's [Observe] stance on the pantry door) and NOT (13,6) (portals.json's `the_wandering_inn` arrival cell, and portal_menu_start's own player position). Save-compat: open neighbours (12,5)/(13,4)/(13,6)/(14,5) -- and no pre-restructure save can hold door_retrieved at all, so the new blocker can strand nothing.
entities.observe: He has taken his coat off, which for Pisces is manual labour. One hand rests flat on the hauled door's face, the way a physician rests a hand on a patient, and he is listening to something no one else in the room can hear.

dialogue.speaker: Pisces
dialogue.text: A moment. I am counting the ward's repeats, and you are extremely countable.

entities._comment: `allies:["relc"]`/`ally_requires:{met_relc:1}` mirrors D2's own harness gated cell (`rift_vermin_leak_w8_relc`, the 0.55-0.95 tuned band) rather than the harder ungated `_solo` variant. GH#150: encounter_when arms the FIGHT on the door chain (present_when is validator-forbidden on encounters -- trigger_radius never consults presence). Pre-quest the leak stays VISIBLE as inert foreshadowing with its own observe; hiding it would recreate #149's invisible-blocking-cell class mid-floor. Display/fight text unchanged post-arm. 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.4): the arming counter moved door_chain_started -> door_mounted, and the fiction moved with it. Nothing leaked through the pantry wall while the pantry door was a pantry door; the leak is what the MOUNTED Magical Door lets through when it strains at a distance it cannot yet hold. Old saves reach door_mounted through Task 2.6's backfill.
entities.observe: Something scratches behind the pantry wall, patient and small. Probably nothing. Probably.

visual_states.observe: The scratching has become a chewing. The Door strains for somewhere it cannot reach yet, and something on the way there has found the gap and has teeth.

entities._comment: CONSTRAINT: the free approach cell is (3,7), facing down (same column as before, shifted onto the wall). GH#128: the vine door must be EARNED -- base sprite stays garden_door_inner but the at:0 visual_state (always satisfied) hides it, and the at:1 entry un-hides + swaps observe once garden_door_unlocked banks (order-sensitive later-satisfied-wins, world.gd _resolve_entity_render; hidden is render-only per wi_game.gd entity_present doc -- the bare-wall interact/observe/toast still work). door_when already gates traversal on the same counter, so sight and passage flip together at the sleep beat. visual_states re-render live on the counter change (_refresh_entity_visual), so no same-map staleness. GH#149: (3,8) joined the map's blocked set so the pre-unlock cell READS as wall (fallback-blocked tile) instead of an invisible bump -- the door only ever needs interact-from-(3,7), never entry, so permanent blocking serves both states.
entities._comment_gh167: present_when (GH#167 user directive): pre-unlock the entity is ABSENT entirely -- no invisible bump, no wall-dressing; (3,8) left the static blocked set. The at:0 hidden visual_state is now redundant belt-and-braces.
entities.observe: Plaster, old and thin, and a nail with nothing hung on it. If something is meant to be here, it isn't yet.
entities.toast: Bare wall. A nail with nothing hung on it.

door_when.open_toast: The vines part like a curtain, and the light beyond doesn't flicker.

visual_states.observe: A door of living vines, woven shut and breathing faintly of green. It wasn't here before, and it doesn't pretend otherwise.

entities._comment: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.3): no longer pool-only -- the `ceria_intro` graph attaches here so the horns_dig invitation is startable AT THE INN, where a post-seal player actually is (the dungeon_approach attachment stays; the graph is shared, not moved). talk_pool + talk_pool_stages + the static dialogue fallback all STAY: the erin/pisces/krshia/selys idiom is pool-and-graph together (first interact = a pool line, subsequent interacts = the graph), and talk_pool_stages' own gate reads chatted_with_ceria_inn, which only the pool produces.
talk_pool: The couch by the fire is Yvlon's now. Territorial, armswomen.
Pisces keeps asking about the vault door. I told him to bring his own rope this time.
Silver-rank pay, Gold-rank stonework down there. Somebody's math is off, and it isn't mine.

lines: I trained formal, once. Robes, theory, the whole overpriced show. Doesn't come up much anymore, and I like it that way.
You want a tip that's actually useful? Watch the ice before you stand on it. I learned that one the expensive way.
Yvlon says I've gone soft since the inn. I say I've gone SMART. There's a difference, and it involves not getting frostbite on purpose anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Ceria Springwalker
dialogue.text: Ask me about the vault again and I'll start charging Pisces rent.

talk_pool: The inn's quieter than the Guild hall. I'm starting to see why you like it.
My arm's fine. Stop looking.
If the door down there opens, I want to be standing in front of it. That's not bravery — it's just where I stand.

lines: Ask about the arms all you like, now. Silver-steel, shapeable, better grip than flesh ever gave me. I've stopped flinching from the question, so you don't have to either.
Keep your guard up on your off-hand side. Most people forget it exists until something reminds them, and I'd rather you learn it from me than the hard way.
The couch by the fire really is mine. Ceria just likes saying otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: Yvlon Byres
dialogue.text: My arm's still fine.

talk_pool: I have been given a mug of blue fruit juice. I did not ask for it. Erin says this is called 'hospitality.' I am recording it as an asset.
This inn does not have traps. I checked all the floors. Twice.
Captain Ceria says I may sit anywhere. I have chosen the corner with two exits.

lines: I was Prognugator, once. Command caste. I was exiled, is the word Klbkch uses. 'Reassigned' is the word I prefer. Neither changes what happened.
I have counted every safe path between here and the pantry door. If you ever need the fastest one, comrade, ask. I keep the count current.
Erin gave me a name for the corner I sit in. She calls it 'Ksmvr's Post.' I have accepted the designation. It is efficient.

dialogue.speaker: Ksmvr
dialogue.text: I am still counting exits. There are still two.

entities._comment: 2026-07-26 Task 2.7 (controller-sanctioned fix, P1 RUIN/CAMP-DOUBLE): the Horns were bilocated for the whole of The Dig -- `ceria_inn` gated on seal_kept_reported ALONE while the ruin carried a live camp, so the player could speak to them at the inn and at the camp in the same breath (machine playtest 2026-07-27). The inn row's window is now SPLIT: the original retires at horns_dig_joined -- the counter the CAMP banks, so the swap happens at the ruin with the inn off-screen; retiring at horns_dig_started instead popped all three Horns out of the room mid-sentence while the invitation panel was still open (probe shot 01_MIDCONVO_after_bank.png), which is the very defect this wave is fixing at the plinth, and this twin brings them home at door_mounted -- they come back when the door does, which is what ceria_intro's own door_retrieved hub arm already says ('Still can't believe we carried that thing across the floodplains'). Identical cell/sprite/facing/pool/conversation; only `id` and `present_when` differ. The dig-window inn is Horns-free by construction. NOTE on the stage gate: talk-pool counters are id-derived (social.gd's `chatted_with_%s`), so this row banks `chatted_with_ceria_inn_returned` and its settled stage gates on THAT counter rather than the original's -- gating on the original would have locked the settled lines out forever for anyone who never chatted pre-dig.

entities._comment: GH#92 D3 purchase surface (own conversation -- see room_ledger.json header). kind:npc DELIBERATE on an object: only npc/encounter kinds route interact into start_dialogue; no talk_pool means the conversation opens on the FIRST interact.
entities.observe: The inn's room register, open to today. Lyonette's handwriting could win awards; the prices underneath it could start fights.
